chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) used to say when he drank water:
'Praise be to God who gave us sweet and pure water to drink, and did not give us salty and bitter water to drink, and did not hold us accountable for our sins.'

key_terms.عَذْبًا زُلَالًا: Sweet and pure water — two overlapping adjectives emphasizing the pleasant and wholesome quality of the water
key_terms.مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا: Salty and bitter — describes undrinkable or unpleasant water, contrasted with the blessing of sweet water
key_terms.يُؤَاخِذْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا: Hold us accountable for our sins — a request for divine forgiveness embedded within a prayer of gratitude

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say when drinking water?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) had the practice of reciting a specific prayer of gratitude whenever he drank water. The supplication praises God for the blessing of pure, sweet water and simultaneously asks for forgiveness by acknowledging that God has not punished the believers for their sins. This hadith belongs to a chapter on the etiquette of drinking water, illustrating how even everyday acts were sanctified through prophetic remembrance of God.
word_analysis: gave us to drink/quenched us with

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Quenched us with sweet and fresh, and did not Quench us with salty, bitter, and did not Seize us for our sins’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ariy from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith. ‘
The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, when drinking water would say, ‘
All praise belongs to Allah, who has given us cool and clear water and not of salty and foul smelling kind, and has not yet questioned us because of our sins.’”
